messages:
kai (eng-releases): Heads up — I'm kicking off a config-only rollout now. Changes: default `batch_window_ms` 40 -> 30, low-priority route weight 0.8 -> 0.6, per-tenant timeout 30s -> 25s. Canary: 5% traffic for 10m. No model changes.

deploy-bot: :rocket: canary start recorded at 1739456780. Canary ID: cfg-canary-2026-03-15-01. Monitoring hooks enabled.

sara (SRE): ack. I'll watch p99 latency, error-rate, and KV cache evictions. If p99 > 1500ms or errors > 0.8% we rollback. Setting temporary alert thresholds.

daniel (runtime): noting potential for slightly more KV cache churn with shorter timeouts. Watch `kvcache.evictions_per_min` and `serving.latency_tail_ms{route="low-priority"}`.

ops-oncall: If error-rate jumps above 1% or 5xxs materially trend up, manual rollback criteria. Ping me @ops-oncall immediately.

kai (eng-releases): Added notes to release doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/cfg-2026-03-15 (short summary + rollback steps). Also pinned config version `cfg-v2026-03-15-01` for this rollout.

sara (SRE): Quick queries to watch:
```promql
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route)
quantile(0.99, histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(serving_latency_bucket[5m])))
sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[1m]))
```

If you see a sustained p99 regressing > 20% vs baseline, call it.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic at 5% — 2m elapsed. No alerts fired so far.

daniel (runtime): Seeing a small bump in low-priority p95 at tail (about +12%). p99 unchanged. KV evictions up but within historical spike window.

sara (SRE): good. keep an eye for correlated error spikes. I'll let you know if we need to hold.

(8m later)

deploy-bot: Canary 10m elapsed. No hard alerts. Summary: errors = 0.12%, p99 overall +5%, low-priority p99 +18%, kvcache_evictions +22% (transient). Recommend gradual ramp to 25% for 15m.

ops-oncall: +1 to ramp. Hold if error-rate >0.8% or if p99 > 1500ms.

kai (eng-releases): ramping to 25% for 15m and will watch. Rolling plan: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m checks. Rollback playbook in doc if needed.

sara (SRE): one more check — metric to watch for customer-facing impact: `user_request_timeouts_total`. If that trends up, rollback immediately.

(after ramp window)

deniel (runtime): typo — "daniel" here. After ramp to 25% we saw p99 evening back to +6% vs baseline, errors stable. No user timeouts. KV eviction cooler off. All green from runtime side.

ops-oncall: All clear from oncall. Proceed to 50%.

kai (eng-releases): rolling to 50% now. I'll update rollout status and ship short release note: "Config-only: tuned batching and routing weights to reduce cost and slightly tighten timeouts; monitored for 1h." Link pushed to channel.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 50% recorded. Next checkpoint at +15m.

sara (SRE): thumbs up. I'll keep this pinned on the SRE dashboard for an extra hour.

(final)

kai (eng-releases): Rollout reached 100% at 1739456895. No rollback needed. Config remains pinned `cfg-v2026-03-15-01`. If you catch any regressions, revert via the rollback steps in the release doc and ping this thread.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: rollout complete. Canary ID cfg-canary-2026-03-15-01. Audit log updated.

ops-oncall: nice job team — marking post-deploy monitoring for 1h."
